feature: Add comprehensive test coverage for production and purchasing apps
workflow_rationale: This is a multi-phase testing implementation covering two distinct Django apps with multiple models each. A feature workflow allows systematic test creation for production app first, then purchasing app, with verification at each stage.

phases.name: Production App Tests
phases.description: Create comprehensive test coverage for all production app models (ProductionOrder, Bin, BinHistory, Batch, BatchItem)

subtasks.notes:
Created comprehensive ProductionOrder model tests with 20 test cases covering:
- Basic creation and auto-generated order numbers
- String representation
- Unique constraints
- Properties: completion_percentage, is_overdue
- Methods: can_start(), start(), complete()
- Validations for negative and zero quantities
All tests pass successfully.

subtasks.description: Create Bin and BinHistory model tests

verification.expected: All Bin and BinHistory tests pass

subtasks.notes: Successfully created comprehensive tests for Bin and BinHistory models. All 27 tests passing, including tests for: bin creation, auto-code generation, unique constraints, properties (is_empty, is_loaded), load/unload operations, validation, and BinHistory creation through proper Bin methods.

subtasks.description: Create Batch and BatchItem model tests

verification.expected: All Batch and BatchItem tests pass

test_coverage: test_add_bin_material - Add material from bin to batch
test_complete_batch - Complete batch and update order
subtasks.notes: Successfully created comprehensive tests for Batch and BatchItem models. Added 28 tests total (21 for Batch, 7 for BatchItem) covering CRUD operations, properties, methods, validation, status transitions, and relationships. All tests passing. Followed patterns from inventory/tests.py.

subtasks.description: Run all production app tests and verify coverage

verification.expected: All production app tests pass with comprehensive coverage

subtasks.notes:
Successfully ran all production app tests. All 75 tests passed in ~27-33 seconds. Test breakdown:
- ProductionOrderTestCase: 20 tests (order creation, auto-numbering, properties, methods, validations)
- BinTestCase: 19 tests (bin creation, loading/unloading, properties, validations)
- BinHistoryTestCase: 9 tests (history tracking, movement types, ordering)
- BatchTestCase: 21 tests (batch creation, material collection, status transitions, validations)
- BatchItemTestCase: 6 tests (item creation, relationships, string representation)

Comprehensive coverage achieved for all 5 production app models with proper validation, business logic, and edge case testing.

phases.name: Purchasing App Tests
phases.description: Create comprehensive test coverage for all purchasing app models (PurchaseRequest, PurchaseOrder, Receiving and their items)

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive tests for PurchaseRequest and PurchaseRequestItem models. All 17 tests passing, covering creation, validation, unique constraints, properties, and workflow.

Successfully created comprehensive tests for PurchaseOrder and PurchaseOrderItem models. Added 11 tests for PurchaseOrder covering creation, reference number generation, properties (total_value, total_received, can_receive), and status workflow. Added 10 tests for PurchaseOrderItem covering creation, properties (total_price, pending_quantity, is_fully_received), validation, and partial receiving. All 21 tests pass successfully.

Created comprehensive tests for Receiving and ReceivingItem models. All 18 tests passing. Covers creation, validation, properties, status workflows, and various receiving scenarios including partial/full acceptance and rejection.

subtasks.description: Run all purchasing app tests and verify coverage

verification.expected: All purchasing app tests pass with comprehensive coverage

subtasks.notes:
Successfully ran all purchasing app tests. All 56 tests passed in ~25.7 seconds. Test breakdown:
- PurchaseRequestTestCase: 9 tests (request creation, reference number generation, properties, approval workflow, validations)
- PurchaseRequestItemTestCase: 8 tests (item creation, total_price calculation, validations, multiple items)
- PurchaseOrderTestCase: 10 tests (order creation, reference number generation, properties, status workflow, relationships)
- PurchaseOrderItemTestCase: 11 tests (item creation, total_price, pending_quantity, is_fully_received properties, partial receiving, validations)
- ReceivingTestCase: 7 tests (receiving creation, reference number generation, status workflow, total_received_value property)
- ReceivingItemTestCase: 11 tests (item creation, acceptance/rejection scenarios, total_value calculation, batch tracking, validations)

Comprehensive coverage achieved for all 6 purchasing app models (PurchaseRequest, PurchaseRequestItem, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderItem, Receiving, ReceivingItem) with proper validation, business logic, properties, and workflow testing.
